items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Sonny was indeed a dear friend.

ctx.x: . . . and you referred to him as your saxophonist [Baker pronounces the word saxophonist with the emphasis on the second syllable, as Johnson did on the television show when introducing Sonny Stitt]. [laughter] That’s great.
Yeah, Sonny was indeed a dear friend.
Around this time also was when you met Miles Davis. Had you met him previous to being contracted to do the two tracks on The Birth of the Cool, or was that your first encounter with him?
